title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E9 — Exploring Korean Cuisine
Martha dines at the Korean restaurant NARO and begins her culinary journey with two Korean cocktails; Martha and executive chef Nate Kuester make reimagined versions of traditional Korean cuisine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E10 — Martha's Favorite Brunch
Martha prepares a brunch menu with whitefish salad from Acme Smoked Fish Corp and crafts a cocktail featuring two brunch staples; Martha makes her favorite frittata dish and bakes a rhubarb crisp.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E1 — Ice Cream Show
Martha makes homemade ice cream with Van Leeuwen Ice Cream co-founder, Ben Van Leeuwen; Martha assembles ice cream sandwiches with homemade cookies and makes hot fudge.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E3 — Mexican Cuisine
Chef Lazaro Perez joins Martha in her kitchen to cook a fiesta-inspired feast of carnitas and homemade tortillas, shrimp in a spicy chili sauce, and the iconic Martha-rita.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E4 — Arethusa Farm Dairy's Award Winning Cheese
Martha road trips to Arethusa Farm in Bantam, CT, and learns how they make their award-winning Europa cheese, visits their cheese caves, and makes their delicious cheesy risotto recipe.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E5 — Brioche, Tarts and Pie
Chef Margarita Lorenzana-Manzke visits Martha's Maple Avenue kitchen and shares recipes of her famous staples from her restaurant, Republique, like banana caramel cream pie and brioche loaves.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E6 — Tomato Show
Martha shares her favorite tomato recipes from a tomato tart to Martha's favorite BLT to a simple marinara sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E7 — French Bistro Night
Martha gets a first-hand look behind the delicious French dishes at Cenadou Bistro including mussels in a tomato sauce with house-made croutons and a flatbread topped with olives and anchovies.

Sorrel soup; pasta with grilled sardines and bitter greens; Swiss chard frittata; kale Caesar salad; escarole.

Stovetop clambake in a stockpot; risotto with shrimp and herbs in a pressure cooker; poached cod with tomatoes in a skillet; arroz con pollo in a Dutch oven.

Baked stuffed clams; searing a porterhouse steak; creamed spinach; baked potatoes with various garnishes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:

Buckwheat crêpes filled with a mushroom mixture; vegetarian mushroom ragù served on rigatoni; French mushroom soup; mushroom risotto made with farro.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E9 — Cooking With Wine
Beef bourguignon; cioppino, a tomato and wine-based fish stew; chicken Marsala; poached pears in red or white wine.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E3 — Amazing Houseplants
Martha brings the outdoors inside the home and shares her love of houseplants; she shows how to take care of the most popular houseplants and how to propagate them to create new plants.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E4 — The World of Succulents
Martha explores how to care for succulents including watering, fertilizing, and repotting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E5 — Inside Martha's Vegetable Greenhouse; Seed Starting
Martha takes us inside her vegetable greenhouse to see how she has turned her harvest into a year-round bounty; she collects, stores, and sows seeds, and makes her perfect green drink.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E6 — The Incredible World of Orchids
Martha visits the incredible Orchid Show at the New York Botanical Garden; this year's show immerses you in a mesmerizing array of orchids designed by acclaimed artist Lily Kwong.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E7 — Hens and Chicks
Now with over 200 chickens and 20 different breeds, Martha shares her vast knowledge about raising and caring for her flock; learn the how-tos of building a coop.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E8 — Martha Builds a Raised Bed Vegetable Garden
Martha builds a brand new, half-acre raised bed vegetable garden on her farm! It's a step-by-step guide to designing, building, preparing the soil, and planting.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E9 — Everything's Coming Up Roses
Everything is coming up roses on Martha's Bedford farm; Martha is creating a brand-new rose garden with almost 200 roses; from color to fragrance, the inspired world of roses is a very good thing.
